You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges. When parcel volumes increase unexpectedly or a process slows down, you quickly assess the situation and help find a practical solution. Thanks to your support, the team can continue working efficiently.

You will be part of a close-knit team where cooperation is important. Colleagues help one another, communicate openly, and work towards the same goal: delivering excellent operational results.

Your responsibilities include:

• Supporting, guiding, and coaching operational employees.
• Monitoring parcel flows, quality, and productivity.
• Identifying and resolving operational issues.
• Training and onboarding new team members.
• Assisting the Team Leader with daily administration and operational tasks

We are looking for someone with logistics experience who enjoys taking responsibility and supporting colleagues during daily operations.

For this position, it is important that you have:

• VMBO, LBO, or equivalent working and thinking level.
• At least 2 years of experience in logistics, warehousing, or an operational environment.
• Good communication skills in English. Dutch is an advantage.
• Experience supporting, guiding, or coordinating colleagues.
• Willingness to work rotating shifts within a 24/7 operation.
